Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 8

Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in the final analysis by stating that the main characters of The Godfather were co-created by Mario Puzo and Francis Ford Coppola. While Francis Ford Coppola contributed to the film adaptation and screenplay, the original creation of the characters in the novel was solely by Mario Puzo. The task was to identify the creator of the main character, which in the context of character creation refers to the author of the novel, Mario Puzo. The Planner incorrectly attributed co-creation to Coppola, who was involved in the adaptation process but did not create the characters.
